# nuttyfelt

> Hong Kong studio making handmade realistic needle-felted cat half-bust portraits on a brass/gold halo with an easel stand.

Site: https://nuttyfelt-web-production.up.railway.app
Languages: Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong wording) default; English at /en
Social: Instagram and Threads @nuttyfelt

## Offering

- Custom commission only — not stock products on a shelf
- Regular price: HK$5,000 (short- or long-hair; complex coloring not charged extra)
- Early-bird: HK$4,250 for the first 3 clients (Instagram post + written testimonial required)
- Halo size: short-hair about 13 cm; long-hair about 15 cm
- Included: portrait on metal halo, easel stand, one black-and-white hand-drawn cat portrait, protective wax
- Capacity: about one commission per month; making time about 3–4 weeks
- Reply aim: within 3 days on photo sufficiency and scheduled month

## Not offered

- Open-mouth or special expressions
- Collars or accessories
- Rush orders

## Process summary

1. Client submits the commission form with reference photos (no Google sign-in)
2. Artist confirms photos and month; 50% deposit due within 3 days of confirmation
3. Handmade work; multi-angle review photos/video; balance due; up to 2 minor revisions
4. Handover: Hong Kong SF Express freight collect or South Island Line station meetup; overseas shipping at cost (duties by client)

Payment stays off-site: FPS / PayMe (HK), PayPal (overseas).

## Public pages

- / — Home
- /works — Selected finished works
- /halo — Halo presentation details
- /process — Full process / terms
- /about — Studio
- /faq — FAQ
- /commission — Commission request form

English mirrors: prefix paths with /en (e.g. /en/process).

## Privacy

- Cat living-status and private contact details are never published
- Client reference photos are private; not used on marketing pages
- Publicity consent (tag / do not tag) is required to accept an order
